query: SELECT id,endpoint,introduced_by FROM discovery_sources WHERE enabled AND (CASE WHEN 'video_catalogue'=ANY(capabilities) OR endpoint LIKE '%/api/v1/videos' THEN $3 WHEN 'community_directory'=ANY(capabilities) OR endpoint LIKE '%/api/v3/community/list' THEN $2 ELSE $1 AND endpoint LIKE '%/api/v1/directory' END) AND (cooldown_until IS NULL OR cooldown_until<=clock_timestamp()) AND (verified_at IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM discovery_sampling p WHERE p.source_id=discovery_sources.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM discovery_sampling p WHERE p.source_id=discovery_sources.id AND p.next_at<=clock_timestamp())) ORDER BY valid_until NULLS FIRST,id LIMIT 32
